Interaction Description: Tyr192 recognizes the imine nitrogen in the triazole-linked imine segment.
Tyr192 also stacks against the benzodioxole aromatic ring.
Tyr268 makes a second aromatic stacking interaction with the benzodioxole system.
Lys266 engages the benzodioxole ring through a pi-cation interaction.
Glu152 accepts a hydrogen bond from the benzimidazole NH of the terminal nitrobenzimidazole fragment.
Lys154 stabilizes the terminal nitro-substituted heteroaryl ring.
